# One designated build artifact per template

**`dist/`** — the built output. It is regenerated by `npm run build` and must never be committed by hand. Kept out of git by `.gitignore`.

**`src/content/`** — the only place site copy lives. Editing a `.astro` file to change wording is a defect; the content purity check will fail the build.

**`src/config/site.ts`** — the only file that needs changing when reusing a template for a new subject (`url`, then `SITEMAP_OPEN` for launch phase).
